Verified strict preflight, release/privacy + CI safety tests, diff check, and appstore preflight.

Verified focused degraded-envelope test, full BackendClientCraftAPITests slice on iPhone 17, strict preflight, and diff check.

Verified JS check, diff check, route unit slice, mac harness build, and expanded relaunch restore smoke.
